from appium import webdriver
from appium.options.android import UiAutomator2Options
options = UiAutomator2Options().load_capabilities({
    'platformName': 'Android',
    'appium:automationName': 'UiAutomator2',
    'appium:udid': 'emulator-5554',
    'appium:noReset': True,
    'appium:autoLaunch': False,
    'appium:skipUnlock': True,
    'appium:newCommandTimeout': 300,
})
driver = webdriver.Remote('http://127.0.0.1:50581', options=options)
session_id = driver.session_id
{'sessionId': session_id, 'newCommandTimeout': driver.capabilities.get('newCommandTimeout', driver.capabilities.get('appium:newCommandTimeout'))}

driver.swipe(540, 2050, 540, 500, 500)
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
WebDriverWait(driver, 5).until(lambda d: 'All apps' in d.page_source or 'Apps list' in d.page_source or d.current_activity != '.NexusLauncherActivity')
{'package':driver.current_package,'activity':driver.current_activity}

from appium.webdriver.common.appiumby import AppiumBy
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
driver.find_element(AppiumBy.ACCESSIBILITY_ID, 'Tasks').click()
WebDriverWait(driver, 10).until(lambda d: d.current_package != 'com.google.android.apps.nexuslauncher')
{'package':driver.current_package,'activity':driver.current_activity}
